notes.title: Mouse Bug Fix
notes.notes: Just fixed a problem with our last build that was affecting mouse controls.

notes.title: v2.11 Update
notes.notes:
Larger UI on player select screen. 
Any gameplad works for controlling any menus. 
Fixed bug where you couldn't start new games with the mouse from the game over screen.
Update spider spawn sound.

notes.title: V2.1 Update Notes - Updates for Steam Deck playability
notes.notes:
Larger text for in-game quotes.
Larger instructions on game start.
Added game start quotes. 
Added artwork for Steam Deck library.
Updated CRT filter. 
Updated version of MonoGame used.
Improved error logging.

notes.title: CRT Mode in latest update
notes.notes:
We just uploaded an update that adds a "CRT Mode" option under the Options screen. This gives Bad Caterpillar the look of playing it on a classic arcade / console. 

I think you guys and gals will enjoy it. And if there are other things you'd like to see us add, please let us know in the comments! 

- Kris
